roleContext.roleTitle: Technical Project Manager, Data Platform Migration
roleContext.jobDescription: The data platform migration moves the company's analytics workloads from the on-premise warehouse to the cloud data platform over eighteen months. The Technical Project Manager runs the migration's workstreams under the company's delivery method: the migration plan and the cut-over schedule, the weekly steering report, the dependency management with the data engineering and analytics teams, and the closure of each workstream with its acceptance evidence. Cut-over approvals stay with the head of data platform. Reports to the head of data platform; works with the data engineering teams, the analytics teams and the cloud provider's migration specialists.

requirements.text: Runs migration workstreams under the company's delivery method, including the migration plan and the cut-over schedule.
Prepares the weekly steering report for the head of data platform.
Manages dependencies with the data engineering and analytics teams through the method's dependency register.
Prepares cut-over readiness reviews, with cut-over approval staying with the head of data platform, and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents workstream boundaries and acceptance evidence at closure.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Technical Project Manager, Data Platform Migration

## Experience

- Technical project manager on the data platform migration of a software company for two years, running the migration's five workstreams under the company's delivery method with the migration plan and the cut-over schedule.
- Prepared the weekly steering report for the head of data platform, filed with the steering decisions in the migration folder.
- Managed the dependencies with the four data engineering teams and the three analytics teams through the method's dependency register, escalating two blocked dependencies to the steering meeting.
- Prepared the cut-over readiness review for each of the eleven cut-overs; the cut-over approval was the head of data platform's, recorded on the readiness review, which also records which checks were mine and which the engineering teams'.
- Wrote the closure report for each workstream with the workstream boundary statement and the acceptance evidence signed by the analytics team leads.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the migration plan with its cut-over schedule, one weekly steering report, one cut-over readiness review with the approval record and one workstream closure report, with the migration folder references as a verification trail.
